say:1:1430104501:1.text: Who else? I'm talking about all of Brimstone Village.
say:1:1430104501:1.source_cn: 还能指谁，当然是整个深岩村！

say:2:1430104502:1.text: At first, only Eldric and his followers were worried. However, for some reason, emotions are running high and that's spread to the entire village.
say:2:1430104502:1.source_cn: 一开始忧心的只有跟着弗林的那伙儿。结果不知道怎么回事，...

say:3:1430104503:1.text: Some have actually told me they have no appetite!
say:3:1430104503:1.source_cn: 直到最近，他们竟然跟我说没胃口。

say:4:1430104504:1.text: Can you believe it? Who's ever heard of a Dwarf with no appetite?!
say:4:1430104504:1.source_cn: 见鬼，矮人什么都可以没有，唯独不能没胃口！
